<!-- Source page: Nix User Repository -->

The **Nix User Repository** (**NUR**) is a community-driven repository for Nix packages. In contrast to <a href="Nixpkgs" class="wikilink" title="Nixpkgs">Nixpkgs</a>, packages are not reviewed by any Nixpkgs member.

## External links

- [GitHub](https://github.com/nix-community/NUR)
- [Package search](https://nur.nix-community.org/)
